title_ar: حالات تتشابه في الصورة ويختلف علاجها
title_en: Cases that look alike in a photo but need different treatments
notes: Arabic case, option and treatment text is DGDA's wording, copied as written. English is the team's translation.
Which damage_type values trigger a pair, the row rule, and which evidence goes with which pair are team decisions. Each pair lists them under assumptions.
The agent never picks one of the two options. It shows both and asks for the evidence; the conservator decides.

options.label_en: surface shrinkage crack in the plaster

pairs.note_ar: الشق قد يكون انكماشاً سطحياً في اللياسة أو شقاً إنشائياً في جسم الجدار
assumptions: DGDA names a vertical crack. A finding has no crack direction, so the pair applies to every crack: missing a structural crack costs more than one extra question (DGDA Q9).
intervention_history is included because of the Al-Dhawihra mosque case (DGDA Q3): loads from a past repair caused the damage.

pairs.note_ar: البقعة الداكنة عند القاعدة قد تكون رطوبة صاعدة نشطة أو أثراً قديماً جافاً
assumptions: The glossary has no stain class. A dark patch at the foot of the wall is reported as base_erosion, as in contracts/v2/examples/capture_results.json, so the pair is attached to base_erosion.
Only on the base row (R1): DGDA's case is a stain at the base.

options.label_en: natural end of life of the sacrificial plaster

options.label_ar: انفصال بسبب لياسة إسمنتية غير متوافقة
options.label_en: detachment caused by an incompatible cement plaster

pairs.note_ar: تساقط اللياسة قد يكون نهاية عمرها الطبيعي أو انفصالاً بسبب لياسة إسمنتية غير متوافقة

options.label_en: water runoff from a damaged scupper
options.treatment_en: repair the scupper, then fill the groove

pairs.note_ar: الأخدود قد يكون من جريان مياه مرزام تالف أو من تآكل الرياح

options.treatment_en: treat the moisture and remove the salts

options.label_en: lime residue or a recent repair

pairs.note_ar: البقع البيضاء قد تكون تزهّر أملاح أو بقايا جير أو ترميم حديث
السطح المتجانس قد يكون نسيجاً أصلياً سليماً أو ترميماً حديثاً يخفي تلفاً تحته
assumptions: A smooth surface is not damage, so no damage class finds it. The detector only reports such a patch as a suspected incompatible_repair, so the pair is attached to incompatible_repair. DGDA Q8 also lists 'plaster that looks intact but is an incompatible past repair, such as cement mortar'.

pairs.note_ar: الفجوة قد تكون جحر قوارض أو حشرات أو فتحة أصلية للتهوية أو لتثبيت الخشب
assumptions: None of DGDA's eight evidence items tells a burrow from an original opening, so this pair uses two items from DGDA's routine inspection checklist (Q1): signs of insects or rodents, and comparison with the previous inspection.

not_paired.structural_deformation: Suspected only and always referred to the specialist (DGDA Q11); no look-alike question.
not_paired.parapet_loss: Bonus type; DGDA lists no look-alike case for it.
not_paired.timber_decay: Bonus type; DGDA lists no look-alike case for it.
not_paired.biological_growth: Bonus type; DGDA lists no look-alike case for it.
